About the instruction audio

Listen reads the public instructions aloud. You can always read the same instructions on screen.

Your entries stay private

Your account entries are not used to make these recordings and are not sent to a voice service. Recordings are prepared before publishing; you do not need to download a speech model or install a voice.

Listening and saved audio

Audio downloads only when you choose Listen. Your browser can keep recent public recordings so you can replay them, including without a connection. A recording you have not played before still needs a connection.

To remove saved recordings, open Reading & listening in Virasat, then open the saved audio section and choose the option to clear audio. This does not clear your account records.

Saved audio is limited to 12 MiB or 256 recordings, whichever limit is reached first. Browser storage can be unavailable or cleared by the browser. Website hosting logs can include your IP address and the files you request.

Computer-generated voices

These are synthetic prototype voices. They have not yet passed fluent-speaker checks for pronunciation, accent and understanding. If a word is unclear, use the text on screen and the official institution's instructions.

Bundled recordings are currently available in English, Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Tamil, Urdu, Gujarati, Punjabi, Kannada, Telugu, Malayalam, Assamese, Odia, Dogri and Maithili. A language offered for text does not automatically have recordings. No person's voice was cloned for this project.
